lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Five years later, below the citadel.|A friendly match. Supposedly.
lines.text: Five years later, below the citadel. A friendly match. Supposedly.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Five banners. The first to hold three while|the bell counts thirty wins. Nobody gets hurt.
lines.text: Five banners. The first to hold three while the bell counts thirty wins. Nobody gets hurt.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Define hurt. ...Kidding! Malrik,|you take the shady side. You like it there.
lines.text: Define hurt. ...Kidding! Malrik, you take the shady side. You like it there.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Of course. The side nobody picked.|I have had a great deal of practice with those.
lines.text: Of course. The side nobody picked. I have had a great deal of practice with those.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: She'll take the field in five minutes.|He'll take it in the last one.
lines.text: She'll take the field in five minutes. He'll take it in the last one.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I'm cheering for the grass.|Nobody ever cheers for the grass.
lines.text: I'm cheering for the grass. Nobody ever cheers for the grass.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Three! Ring it, Vey! Ring it, ring it, ring it!
lines.text: Three! Ring it, Vey! Ring it, ring it, ring it!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Thirty, girl. Count with me. One...
lines.text: Thirty, girl. Count with me. One...

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: There she goes. She never looks|behind her. Somebody should.
lines.text: There she goes. She never looks behind her. Somebody should.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Hey! That's MY banner! You can't just take it!
lines.text: Hey! That's MY banner! You can't just take it!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I was given the leftovers, Vessa.|I have learned to take the rest.
lines.text: I was given the leftovers, Vessa. I have learned to take the rest.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: The bell counts for Malrik.
lines.text: The bell counts for Malrik.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Ow! Fine! I yield! This counts as a tie!
lines.text: Ow! Fine! I yield! This counts as a tie!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: It does not count as a tie.
lines.text: It does not count as a tie.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Did anyone see him move? No. Nobody ever does.
lines.text: Did anyone see him move? No. Nobody ever does.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Her banner, her crystals.|Fire is generous when it isn't looking.
lines.text: Her banner, her crystals. Fire is generous when it isn't looking.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Malrik wins. By taking.
lines.text: Malrik wins. By taking.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: You taught us to use what we were given.|I was given leftovers. I used them.
lines.text: You taught us to use what we were given. I was given leftovers. I used them.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: ...Yes. Well played.
lines.text: ...Yes. Well played.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Rematch. Now. Best of three. Best of five!
lines.text: Rematch. Now. Best of three. Best of five!

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Later, my joy. Both of you, come up to|the orrery. I have something for you.
lines.text: Later, my joy. Both of you, come up to the orrery. I have something for you.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I yield. ...This time.
lines.text: I yield. ...This time.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Thirty! Fair and square!|Malrik, you can keep the shade!
lines.text: Thirty! Fair and square! Malrik, you can keep the shade!
